doc.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022

title: Mr. DeVoe and the high school Senior Revue
summary: The encouraging music director Mr. DeVoe let him jam with his trio and play two songs in the Senior Revue, his first public performance.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Oh I have to make sure we spell this man’s name right, ‘cause he’s important.

Mr. DeVoe. And he was so encouraging. He knew I had a passion for it and he encouraged it, you know, and he’d give me the — he’d sign a pass for me saying, and I actually did play on the Senior Revue, I did two songs which was total head-scratching to the audience. Not only did I not know what I was doing, they certainly didn’t know what I was doing. And that was my first public performance you know.
